description: This file defines the DuplexPipe class implementing IDuplexPipe, providing methods to create paired duplex pipes for network communication, including a workaround for .NET Framework issues with value tuples.

classes.name: DuplexPipe
classes.description: Implements IDuplexPipe, encapsulating a PipeReader and PipeWriter, and provides a static method to create connection pairs.

classes.name: DuplexPipePair
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a pair of duplex pipes, used to work around .NET Framework issues with value tuples.

methods.name: CreateConnectionPair
methods.description: Creates a pair of DuplexPipe instances representing the transport and application ends of a duplex connection, configured with specified PipeOptions.

methods.name: DuplexPipe
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DuplexPipe with given PipeReader and PipeWriter.

methods.name: DuplexPipePair
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DuplexPipePair with transport and application IDuplexPipe instances.
